metadata.appDescription: Writing Coach provides a skill-based coaching system for writers, combining focused objectives, progressive skill tracking, targeted prompts, and detailed review feedback.

statusState.signInRequiredBody: Sign in to open this page.
statusState.pageUnavailableBody: The page or record you requested could not be found in this practice path.
statusState.serverErrorBody: A server error came back while loading this page.

trackManagementCard.title: Archive this practice path
trackManagementCard.description: This hides the practice path from the switcher but keeps its assignment history and progress.

onboardingView.archiveConfirm: Archive this practice path? Its history will be kept, but it will be removed from your active practice paths.
onboardingView.setupIntro: Tell us what kind of writing you want to practice first.
onboardingView.createIntro: Start another practice path for a different kind of writing.
onboardingView.editIntro: Update this practice path’s focus, tone, and goals.
onboardingView.startingPointIntro: Tell us what kind of writing you want to improve first.
onboardingView.calloutTitle: Next, create your first practice path
onboardingView.calloutBody: Your answers shape what you practice next.
onboardingView.calloutBullet1: Describe the kind of writing you want to practice most often.
onboardingView.calloutBullet2: Pick the audience, tone, and outcomes you want the coach to optimize for.
onboardingView.calloutBullet3: Saving this step takes you straight to Step 3 of 3: your first assignment.
onboardingView.howItWorksBody1: You work on up to three skills at a time.
onboardingView.howItWorksBody2: Each assignment and each round of feedback stays focused on those skills.
onboardingView.howItWorksBody3: As you improve, older skills are checked more lightly and new ones open up.

newAssignmentView.title: New assignment
newAssignmentView.setupIntro: Choose the three skills you want your first assignment to build.
newAssignmentView.intro: Choose the three skills you want this assignment to build.
newAssignmentView.calloutTitle: Finish by generating your first assignment
newAssignmentView.calloutBody: Pick three skills, generate an assignment, and use it. Once you do, the full writing workspace becomes your normal home.
newAssignmentView.calloutBullet1: Keep the selection to exactly three skills.
newAssignmentView.calloutBullet2: Generate the assignment, then try another if the first version misses the mark.
newAssignmentView.calloutBullet3: Use the assignment to enter the current assignment workspace.
newAssignmentView.focusDescription: Pick the three skills you want this assignment to focus on.
newAssignmentView.generationBody: Creating a new assignment for this practice path. This usually takes a few seconds.

currentAssignmentView.signInBody: Once you sign in, this page becomes the current assignment workspace for your active practice path.
currentAssignmentView.noAssignmentIntro: You do not have an active assignment yet. Choose 3 available skills and generate the next assignment.
currentAssignmentView.reviewProgressBody: Your draft is saved. You can leave this page while feedback is being prepared.
currentAssignmentView.reviewStep2: Check it against the selected skills.
currentAssignmentView.reviewStep3: Prepare feedback and the next step.
currentAssignmentView.revisionProgressBody: Building a revision brief from your latest feedback.
currentAssignmentView.revisionStep2: Pull out the highest-priority revision targets.
currentAssignmentView.reviewFailedBody: Your draft was saved, but the feedback job did not finish. You can retry without losing your work.
currentAssignmentView.revisionModeDescription: Use the notes below to revise this draft.
currentAssignmentView.lastReviewedDraftLoaded: Your last reviewed draft is already loaded so you can revise it directly.
currentAssignmentView.skillsForAssignmentDescription: The review will focus mainly on these three skills.
currentAssignmentView.writeDescription: Paste your draft, or upload a file, then ask for feedback.
currentAssignmentView.noDraftYet: No draft submitted yet for this assignment.

applicationLayout.switchConfirm: You have an unsaved draft in the current practice path. Switch practice paths and discard those unsaved edits?
